well.depth: 60-120 m (typical Thai deep well), confirm by DGR hydro-survey
well.casing: 150 mm (6") PVC Class 13.5 + steel surface casing, grouted 6 m
well.pump: Submersible 1.5 kW (2 HP), 3 m³/h @ 60 m head, dry-run + low-level cut-out
well.demand: 6 people x 200 L + pool/plunge make-up ≈ 1.5 m³/day; peak 60 L/min
well.test: Lab water test (Fe, Mn, hardness, TDS, pH, nitrate, arsenic, coliform) BEFORE final treatment selection; about 3,000-5,000 THB
train: 2,000 L PE tank, venturi aerator, float + level sensor
30 L resin, brine tank, meter-initiated regen
costs: Drilling 100 m incl. casing, gravel pack, grout, development
Mains backup, RPZ, air gaps, piping, install

items: Home Controller (Home Assistant on Mini-PC) + Zigbee/Thread + UPS
In AV rack 405; local-first, remote via VPN
Rain, wind, temp, RH, solar irradiance
Level Sensors (T-1, T-2, T-3, RT-1, TT-1)
Filter ΔP Sensors + UV Status Relay
Motorized Auto Shut-Off Valve + Flow Meter
On main at 206 entry; closes on any leak
Under sinks, WCs, water heater, washer, AHU, pool room
automations: Pool pump + salt cell run at 10:00-15:00 when PV surplus > 2 kW; minimum 6 h turnover guaranteed
Battery reserve 30% for outages; generator auto-start below 15% or on long outage
Irrigation: skip if rain > 3 mm forecast/24 h or soil moisture above threshold; water at 05:00 from cisterns, well top-up only if T-1..3 < 10%
Leak detected: close SOV, stop BP-1, push alert; daily micro-leak check by flow meter at 03:00
Filter ΔP high: schedule backwash on PV surplus; UV lamp fault: close SOV to house + alert
AC: zone schedules by occupancy, pre-cool on solar surplus, setback 27 °C when away; sauna/steam pre-heat from the app
Energy: per-circuit dashboard, monthly report, alert on abnormal baseload

costs: Herb Nook Sensors (Temp, RH, CO2, pH/EC, Reservoir Level)

sustain: Drilled well + treatment, mains as backup only (P-103)
Home controller: solar-timed pool/irrigation, leak shut-off (E-103)

ERV fresh air with enthalpy core
Healthy air at low cooling cost
Kitchen garden, raised beds, compost + 4-6 hens
